contentText: The United States Congress is about to welcome dozens of new faces. A majority of them, Democratic, after the "blue wave" in the midterm elections. FRANCE 24's Washington correspondent Fraser Jackson catches up with one of these new lawmakers as they go through orientation as they prepare to take office in January. He speaks with Katy Padilla Stout, U.S. Representative-elect for Texas's 23rd congressional district.
